notablePrerequisites:
An opponent has a card in exile.
You control a basic Forest.
"Rat" chosen with Conspiracy.
description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card an opponent owns from exile into their graveyard, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
When the Eldrazi Scion enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Conspiracy, Lord Skitter's first ability triggers, exiling a card from an opponent's graveyard.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Eldrazi Scion, untapping a basic Forest you control.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
